script/0690_room_BattleTower_Lobby.txt.69: Would you like to take the Single\nBattle Room challenge?
script/0690_room_BattleTower_Lobby.txt.71: The Battle Room offers two levels\nof challenge, Level 50 and Open Level.{be00}\nWhich is your choice?
script/0690_room_BattleTower_Lobby.txt.74: Now please select the three Pokémon\nthat are to be entered.
script/0690_room_BattleTower_Lobby.txt.75: Before entering a Battle Room, your\nprogress must be saved. Is that okay?
script/0690_room_BattleTower_Lobby.txt.76: I will now show you to the\nSingle Battle Room.
script/0690_room_BattleTower_Lobby.txt.77: We look forward to seeing you on\nanother challenge!
script/0690_room_BattleTower_Lobby.txt.80: Congratulations!\nYou have defeated the Salon Maiden{be00}\nand swept seven Trainers!
script/0690_room_BattleTower_Lobby.txt.81: In recognition of your infinite talent,\nwe award you these Battle Point(s).
script/0690_room_BattleTower_Lobby.txt.82: Your record will be saved.\nPlease wait.
